query: How tall is the Eiffel Tower in metres?
answer: The Eiffel Tower is 330 metres (about 1,083 ft) tall, measured to the top of its antennas [1][2]. It reached that height on 15 March 2022, when a helicopter installed a new DAB+ radio antenna. That added about 6 metres to the previous height of 324 metres [1]. The iron structure without antennas is about 300 metres, which was its height when it opened for the 1889 World's Fair [2].
